# /crav1-build-features

lane: build | group: Build | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Serial board: build several ready specs one slug after another in this checkout.
use_when: Several specs, one after another
reads: Reads ready spec folders already on the default branch.
writes: Writes the commit-style rule once when it is missing, and a `feat/<slug>` checkout from default per slug.
leaves alone: Leaves product code, commits, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat.
limits: one ready slug stops and points at `/crav1-build-tasks` without running it. When a slice is marked done or retired, it asks once whether to run `/crav1-refresh-system-notes` and does not run it.
flow:
- the spec-branch skill opens only on `spec/<slug>`.
- A dirty tree, a parked spec, a worker status other than `done`, and the picture question are separate files.
- a worker `needs_yes` is waiting.
- The parent offers the Approval needed item and does not write `Approved:`.
- Serial board of ready slugs: `feat/<slug>` from default, then that spec’s build-tasks loop; no parallel, no push, no PR.
- `feat/<slug>` forks from the into branch (Merges into, else default), a task naming a base branch is blocked.
- tasks with `(branch: …)` are built on that branch; the board shows `done (n branches not merged)`.
- each task is built on the build map row from `scripts/build_map.py --recommend T# --vendor copilot`.
- A worker `needs_yes` is waiting, not blocked.
- each task is built on the first line of `--recommend`.
- the same ready-check gate as `/crav1-build-tasks`.
- `ready` and `ready-partial` start `can_start`.
- `not-ready` starts no worker on that slug.
- the T# loop opens `../crav1-build-tasks/branches/several-tasks/BRANCH.md`.
- Branch rules open `../crav1-create-feature-branch/SKILL.md` and its `references/code-branch.md` and `references/task-branch.md`.
- The rule is `docs/reference/open-skill-file.md`.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Opens `/crav1-create-feature-branch` and the several-tasks branch of `/crav1-build-tasks` and follows those files, without re-prompting, and calls `crav1-build-task-agent` one `T#` at a time. It does not start those skills as slash commands.
you run next: /crav1-open-pr
first: `/crav1-build-features <slug-a> <slug-b>`
walkthrough: from-plan-to-build.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.205.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-build-features.md
